Harman’s Rest, Turvey Avenue, Donabate

Co. Dublin

Apply Now 

Applications Close:

  • Starting From

  • Location

  • Bedrooms

  • Availability

Harman’s Rest is located on Turvey Avenue in the established costal village of Donabate in North County Dublin. Donabate is a bustling village with its own shops, schools, and beaches with direct railway and bus links to Dublin city centre. Harman’s Rest is also conveniently located just minutes from the M1 and Dublin airport.

These A rated apartments come with fitted kitchens and white goods to include oven, hob, extractor fan, fridge and washer/dryer. Each apartment has a laminated wooden floor throughout, window covering and fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms.
